title: Video benchmark parity + dynamic product UOM + all-role staff memo
businessRules: Green checkpoint 93e74f6b43aa4a77a38ae21a2cb459b59c0f4993 remains baseline authority; existing completed capabilities are not rewritten without regression evidence.
Manufacturing completion must be atomic: component location stock, inventory ledger, output stock, WIP accounting, moving-average output cost and audit either all commit or all roll back.
Tracked batch/expiry/serial products are fail-closed for production until explicit production traceability exists; the wave must not silently bypass canonical traceability.

PPOB provider calls live in the worker behind encrypted IntegrationConnection + outbox; API business services do not call Digiflazz directly and retries preserve the same provider reference/idempotency identity.
Bulk product import is dry-run first, tenant-scoped, bounded to 1000 rows, and never weakens SKU/barcode uniqueness or HET validation.
HET is an optional per-base-unit ceiling; base, variant and multi-UOM selling prices may not exceed the ceiling after quantity factor conversion.
Setup UI configures business readiness only; schema migration, seed and deployment remain controlled workflow operations and are never exposed as an operator button.
RawBT is an additional Android ESC/POS transport using the same receipt bytes; WebUSB/WebBluetooth/browser printing remain intact fallbacks.
SQLite and PostgreSQL schemas and expand migrations remain semantically aligned; no production db push is introduced.

FIFO cost-layer valuation is not claimed in this wave. Existing inventory costing remains MOVING_AVERAGE unless a complete receipt/consume/return/reversal cost-layer lifecycle is implemented and verified end-to-end.
Product base unit is mandatory and must resolve to an active company-wide UNIT master reference; runtime code may not invent PCS/pcs or another fallback unit.

ProductUnit remains the dynamic packaging authority: arbitrary operator-defined units such as BATANG/BUNGKUS/SLOP, BIJI/LUSIN/RENTENG/DUS use positive safe-integer quantityFactor into the smallest physical base unit.

Changing an existing product base unit is fail-closed after inventory, movement, transaction, pricing, variant, barcode/UOM, return or production history exists; bulk import may not silently rebase an existing SKU.

Staff Memo is personal authenticated staff data scoped to company + active branch + user, rejects API-key identity, uses idempotent create semantics and is exposed on Admin, POS and Employee Portal without granting cross-user visibility.
UAT is expanded, never weakened: browser UAT must resolve an active UNIT dynamically and prove Staff Memo create/idempotent retry/read/pin/archive plus all three authenticated memo surfaces.

R5 asset/fleet date-only fields are company-calendar dates: Fleet/Asset services must resolve them with Company.timezone through the canonical business-time helper; UTC process midnight must not control primary-driver activation, maintenance/depreciation periods, asset dates or fuel dates.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin exposes Produksi workspace with versioned BOM recipes and production order lifecycle from DRAFT through COMPLETED/CANCELLED, permission-aware and tenant/branch scoped.
Production completion consumes canonical location stock, writes PRODUCTION_CONSUME/PRODUCTION_OUTPUT movements, posts balanced WIP journals and updates output moving-average cost atomically.

Admin PPOB workspace can configure encrypted Digiflazz credentials, queue catalog sync, browse cached products, submit idempotent prepaid requests and recheck pending transactions; worker owns provider HTTP calls.
Master product supports optional HET, CSV Excel-compatible export/import with mandatory dry-run and Code128 A4/58mm label printing.
Admin Setup Readiness presents a server-derived checklist without any database migration/seed mutation endpoint.
POS offers RawBT 58mm printing as an additive transport using canonical ESC/POS receipt bytes while existing digital/browser print controls remain available.
Canonical permission seed, module catalog, runtime navigation and role grants include manufacturing and digital_service surfaces without orphan controls.
SQLite/PostgreSQL schema parity, expand migration rehearsal, source audits, dependency-free suite, lint/build, local pre-GitHub UAT and GitHub exact-artifact gates remain green before release.
Master Product base unit selector is sourced only from active company UNIT references; Multi-UOM accepts operator-defined packaging names/factors without hardcoded cigarette/dozen/string unit lists.
Runtime product, POS, Storefront, stock-alert and daily-digest paths have no PCS/pcs fallback; missing/invalid base unit fails visibly instead of changing stock semantics.
Base-unit edit and bulk import preserve historical quantity meaning by rejecting unsafe rebasing once dependent/operational data exists.

Every authenticated staff role has a database-backed personal Memo surface through its normal product surface: Admin, POS or Employee Portal; create/update/pin/archive is tenant/branch/user scoped and audited.

R5 exact-runtime evidence must prove a primary driver effective on the current company business date is projected immediately across the UTC/local-day boundary and is cleared when the assignment ends; date-only asset/fleet operations remain company-timezone aware.
testPlan: Add source-level regression for schema parity, expand migration order, canonical permissions, AppModule registration, admin navigation/operator reachability and RawBT transport.

Manufacturing focused tests assert serializable transaction, location stock consumption/deposit, tracked-product fail-closed rule, WIP posting, idempotent accounting keys and moving-average output cost.
Accounting test: manufacturing completion must produce balanced debit/credit journal entries from inventory to WIP and WIP to finished inventory with stable posting idempotency keys.

PPOB tests assert API never performs provider fetch, worker signs price-list and transaction requests using stable Digiflazz formulas, secrets stay encrypted/redacted, outbox retry is idempotent and CI provider override is localhost-only.
Bulk import tests assert 1000-row bound, dry-run before commit, HET validation, SKU/barcode duplicate rejection, CSV export headers and Code128/label UI reachability.

Run workflow:validate, validate:repo, db:migrations:rehearse:sqlite, db:migrations:rehearse:postgres, test:dependency-free, lint, audit:recovery, audit:full:repo, ci:ui:audit and uat:pre-github:local.

After one atomic push, require Workflow Governance, Full System Simulation and Full Automated UAT success on the same commit; any provider mock must use deterministic localhost CI override and same request contract.

Dynamic-UOM regression asserts all three Prisma schemas require explicit Product.unit, UNIT master ownership, integer conversion factors, no runtime PCS fallback, unsafe rebase rejection and dynamic Admin/Storefront/POS consumption.
Staff Memo regression asserts Prisma parity, expand migration, JWT-only scope, API-key rejection, idempotency hash/unique key, audit events, AppModule wiring and Admin/POS/Employee mounting.

Browser UAT resolves an active UNIT from /master-data/references?type=UNIT and exercises Staff Memo exact-runtime create -> identical retry -> list -> pin -> archive plus authenticated surface selectors.

GitHub post-build regression verifies P5 visual-map/navigation parity including Manufacturing, Stage-19 explicit UNIT masters, and R8 low-stock text with dynamic base-unit labels; no hardcoded 14-workspace or unitless Product fixture may return.

Stage-20 port regression binds an IPv6 wildcard listener on the preferred port and requires selectStage20ApiPort to choose an isolated fallback before Nest starts; this specifically guards the GitHub EADDRINUSE :::42020 failure without changing Stage-20 acceptance.

R5 regression guards FleetService/AssetsService against raw new Date(dateOnly) parsing, exercises the Asia/Makassar UTC-boundary case, and keeps runtime primary-driver projection plus clear-on-end mandatory.
migrationPlan: Apply T360-20261004-video-parity-expansion then T360-20261004-dynamic-uom-staff-memo in registered expand-only order. The second migration adds StaffMemo and removes the PostgreSQL Product.unit default; SQLite keeps any legacy physical column default to avoid table reconstruction, while application writes require an explicit active UNIT. Rehearse SQLite and PostgreSQL before release; production remains migration-only and never uses db push.
rollbackPlan: Before any production data uses the new tables, rollback is application/feature rollback to the green baseline while leaving additive schema in place. Once production orders or digital-service transactions exist, disable the new feature surfaces and provider connection but preserve records/audit; do not destructively drop additive tables or reverse posted inventory/accounting events. Dynamic-UOM/Memo rollback is application-first: keep additive StaffMemo storage and explicit Product.unit values; never restore a runtime fallback unit or rewrite historical stock quantities.
monitoringPlan: Monitor manufacturing completion failures, inventory movement/accounting posting parity, outbox FAILED/retry counts, Digiflazz response codes/latency, digital transaction pending age, catalog sync age, bulk-import audit events and setup-readiness changes. Release evidence must distinguish external-provider readiness from core runtime correctness.
securityNotes: Every new API route remains authenticated, tenant scoped and permission gated. Digiflazz username/API key is accepted only through IntegrationConnection secret encryption and never returned. Provider HTTP is worker-owned; CI base URL override is localhost-only. Bulk import is bounded and validated; setup readiness is read-only; no migration, seed, raw credential or cross-tenant data endpoint is exposed to operators.
notes: One large enhancement wave requested by operator; no intermediate push.
Video is a refinement benchmark, not architecture authority. Existing Toko360 canonical domain rules remain authoritative.
FIFO cost layers are explicitly not claimed by this wave; moving-average costing remains canonical until a full cost-layer lifecycle can be delivered without weakening inventory/accounting UAT.
Implementation complete in one local wave; no intermediate push.
Source-level regression tests/video-parity-expansion.test.mjs PASS 11/11.

Workflow validation PASS (40 items / 8 waves), recovery audit PASS 48/48, full repository audit PASS 1105 files / 526 handlers / 487 controls, contextual map PASS 70/70, P5 visual and UI source audits PASS.
Admin Setup Readiness response shape corrected to server completed/required/optionalConnectedIntegrations contract; Digiflazz credentials now have a permission-aware encrypted operator setup path.
FIFO cost-layer prototype was explicitly removed from this wave because return/transfer/reversal lifecycle was not complete; canonical MOVING_AVERAGE costing remains unchanged.
validate:repo/lint/build/pre-GitHub UAT remain pending on dependency-complete Ubuntu operator repo; artifact container npm ci could not complete and no false PASS is claimed.
Operator explicitly expanded the active single-push candidate to include Dynamic Product UOM/base-unit safety and personal Staff Memo for every staff role; no intermediate commit/push is allowed.

Previous verification evidence before this expansion: dependency-free suite PASS 1676/1676; lint then exposed a real Admin retailCeilingPrice string|number form typing bug, now fixed in source rather than bypassed.

Dynamic-UOM deep runtime regression exposed a stale fixture rather than a production-unit bypass: tests/uom-multilevel-sale-runtime.test.mjs still modeled BANGKOS as base stock and SLOP factor=2 without registering UNIT masters. Root fix now uses the smallest physical base BATANG, registers BATANG/BUNGKUS/SLOP/KARTON/PECAAN through MasterDataService reference APIs, and asserts direct-to-base factors (BUNGKUS=12, SLOP=24, KARTON=120). Existing production master-UNIT validation is preserved unchanged.

Full dependency-free rerun after the first Dynamic-UOM deep-runtime root fix reached 1685 tests with 1657 PASS / 28 FAIL. All 28 failures traced to four legacy runtime fixtures: three raw-SQL suites omitted mandatory Product.unit (NOT NULL) and the consolidated report fixture used PCS through SalesService without materializing an active company UNIT master. Production UNIT validation remains unchanged; fixtures are corrected to configure UNIT explicitly, and a regression guard now scans those runtime fixtures so schema defaults cannot hide this contract again.

Artifact-side verification for the 28-failure fixture root fix: Dynamic-UOM/Staff-Memo source regression including new fixture guard PASS 10/10; workflow validation, recovery/full-repository/product/contextual/canonical/P5/UI audits and diff check PASS. Runtime fixture rerun and validate:repo remain Ubuntu-authoritative because the artifact container lacks complete project-local Prisma/TypeScript binaries.

Exact pushed candidate 7ad44fc8693a4d9a8d168268c2dc89fd2ea70e23 / source fingerprint db458c2bf2f6a932ce0634f0f91f73186220f5c98f0a82278a17c14d48cdfaa7 passed GitHub deterministic install, strict lint/typecheck, six-app build and 1686/1686 regression tests before later exact-runtime gates.

GitHub regression evidence after that push exposed three post-build root blockers, not a generic application failure: P5 visual authority still expected 14 Admin primary screenshots while runtime navigation now has 15 with Manufacturing; Stage-19 created Product rows without mandatory dynamic unit; R8 low-stock probe still expected the pre-UOM text without a unit label. Downstream R8 release/Stage-20 failures were fail-closed consequences of those blockers.

Root fix expands rather than weakens gates: P5 visual coverage is 15 primary + 14 representative contextual routes including /manufacturing/recipes, P5/R7/full-system summary counts derive from visual-map/navigation authority instead of stale 14/13 literals, Stage-19 provisions company-level UNIT masters before Product creation, and R8 asserts available/minStock together with the actual dynamic base-unit code.

Artifact-side focused GitHub blocker regression PASS 22/22; workflow validation PASS; P5 visual audit PASS 15/14; recovery/full-repository/product/contextual/canonical/UI audits PASS. validate:repo remains Ubuntu-authoritative because the artifact workspace lacks the project-local TypeScript package.

Exact GitHub commit acdc733db1df4ba5150369abc6bd4928b4c7df0a / source fingerprint e1468ec80f71c98eaf1e0f4164485321c1a119baf2feff28e7011dce2017f02f passed build/regression/lint, Stage-19, Browser UAT, P5, R8 reporting/security, provider, staging certification, load, index profile and DR, then Stage-20 failed only because its port probe checked 127.0.0.1 while Nest app.listen(port) binds wildcard/IPv6. Root fix makes Stage-20 probe the same wildcard bind semantics and adds a real IPv6 collision regression; UAT/evidence/release gates remain unchanged.

Stage-20 wildcard-port root-fix artifact verification: Stage-20/GitHub/runtime-certification focused regression PASS 46/46; workflow validation PASS; recovery audit PASS 48/48; full repository PASS 1117 files / 529 handlers / 503 controls; product completeness, Admin contextual 70/70, canonical ownership, P5 visual 15/14 and UI source audit 503 controls PASS; diff check PASS. Full validate:repo/dependency-free/lint/UAT remain Ubuntu-authoritative because the artifact container lacks project-local TypeScript/@prisma/client/esbuild.

Exact GitHub commit e5bd9e8465eb14bb23e1c8d43e78bb0f2188a31e / source fingerprint c9200a9d2522e072ae9d62bbab19f60165dad96c00f43a8064711a64d32ccb39 proved the Stage-20 wildcard-port fix: Stage-20 automated readiness PASS and candidate fail-closed assertion PASS with Human Stage-20 still PENDING. The remaining first blocker is R6 daily-summary materialization. Both GitHub workflows ran at 2026-10-04 16:22 UTC, while the seeded company timezone is Asia/Makassar (2026-10-05 local). R6 derived businessDate from UTC via toISOString().slice(0,10), so its newly-created Sale/Journal rows belonged to the next local business day and materialization returned zero aggregates. R8 release then failed only because the required R6 evidence file was absent. Root fix introduces one timezone-aware CI business-date helper sourced from live /auth/branch-context and applies it to R2/R4/R5/R6/P3 probes that mean 'today'; R6 nonzero aggregate assertions remain strict and diagnostics now include timezone/source counts. R8 evidence remains mandatory and unsynthesized.

Latest exact GitHub source b5f7c360e763a5e39bf603f366d2e5ff6f4b8877 / fingerprint 8488c31c7f6605eef0819dd9b07239a26271e424d7c1c0d21ff9f1356ee2df99 passed deterministic build/lint/regression and the prior R6 timezone fix, then exposed a real R5 backend bug: VehicleDriverAssignment effectiveFrom=today was parsed as UTC midnight, so at 2026-10-05 01:22 Asia/Makassar (2026-10-04 17:22 UTC) it was persisted in the future and could not project defaultDriverEmployeeId. Root fix moves FleetService and same-domain AssetsService date-only parsing to canonical parseBusinessDateBoundary + Company.timezone, preserves instant timestamps, treats date-only effectiveTo/periodEnd as company-local end-of-day, and strengthens ci:r5:probe to require activation plus clear-on-end. R8 failure is downstream only because R5 evidence was absent; no R8 fallback/evidence synthesis is added.

R5 verification hardening: the artifact full-suite attempt found two stale asset/fleet integrity assertions that still required the pre-fix UTC parser call shape. Tests now require Company.timezone + canonical parseBusinessDateBoundary semantics instead of reverting production code. Combined affected regression passes 75/75; UAT/release gates remain unchanged and fail-closed.
